full_prompt_en: A square stylized landscape illustration shows small figures gathered by a turquoise pool among rounded golden hills, cream buildings, and towering white clouds. The sky occupies the upper portion in deep blue-green, with two large clustered cloud masses whose soft scalloped tops catch pale cream light and whose lower portions turn blue-gray. Hills rise on both sides as overlapping domes of mustard gold, olive, dark green, and muted teal, their curved bands giving the valley a layered, almost patterned structure. Near the middle, a small group of white blocklike buildings with red roofs stands between the hills, their simple windows and doors providing a crisp scale reference. In the foreground, yellow ground slopes toward the blue-green pool on the right. A few tiny birds or pale reflections punctuate the water, while its bank curves from the center toward the lower right. Several small people in coats and hats stand along the near edge, separated into little groups; a few others occupy the shaded area beneath dark rounded foliage on the left. Their clothing is reduced to tiny colored silhouettes, and individual expressions are not visible. Short upright strokes across the yellow ground suggest coarse grass or grain, while the hills and clouds retain a finely stippled, printed-paper texture. The composition is lit by soft light from the upper left, brightening the cream facades, cloud crowns, and gold slopes while darker green mounds provide gentle broad shadows. There are no strong cast shadows or glossy highlights; depth comes from stacked rounded shapes, small figures, and warm-cool color contrast. The overall composition feels playful and orderly, balancing a dense cluster of dark hills on the left with the open water and rounded golden rise on the right.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形程式化风景插画描绘小人物聚在绿松石色水池旁，四周是圆润金色丘陵、奶油色建筑和高耸白云。上方是一片深蓝绿色天空，两团巨大云块层层聚起，柔软扇贝状云顶接住浅奶油色光，下部转为蓝灰。丘陵从两侧升起，芥末金、橄榄色、深绿和低调青绿圆丘彼此叠压，弯曲色带让山谷具有层层叠起、近乎图案般的结构。中部附近，一组白色块状小楼顶着红屋顶，立于群山之间，简洁门窗提供清楚尺度参考。前景黄色地面向右侧蓝绿水池倾斜。几只小鸟或浅色反光点在水面上，池岸从中央弯向右下。几名穿外套戴帽的小人物分成小组站在近岸，另有少数人在左侧深色圆形树丛下的阴影区。他们的衣着被简化成小彩色剪影，个人神情不可辨。黄色地面上的短直笔暗示粗草或谷粒，山丘与云则保有细点状、印刷纸般肌理。柔光从左上照来，照亮奶油色立面、云顶和金色坡面，较深绿丘提供宽阔而轻柔的阴影。没有强烈投影或光亮高光；纵深来自圆形体块叠放、小人物与冷暖色对比。整体构图俏皮而有序，以左侧密集深丘平衡右侧敞开水面与圆润金坡。
style_prompt_en: The illustration builds a landscape-like rhythm from overlapping rounded color masses, simple upright accents, and a few small crisp rectangles. Mustard gold, olive, and dark green warm the lower areas, while deep teal and turquoise create cool openings; cream highlights stay concentrated near the top and in small focal cuts. Color fields look matte and finely stippled, with enough grain to soften otherwise clean contours. Depth is shallow but legible through layered arcs, reduced scale, and alternating warm and cool bands. Diffuse upper light makes selected crowns and planes glow gently without harsh cast shadows. Broad decorative shapes remain dominant even where tiny details supply a sense of life. The overall finish is calm, playful, and storybook-like, balancing graphic simplification with a tactile printed surface.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅插画以叠合的圆润色块、简洁竖向强调和少量小巧清晰矩形，建立近似风景的节奏。芥末金、橄榄色与深绿温暖下方区域，深青与绿松石色形成冷色开口；奶油色亮部集中在上方及小焦点切口。色域哑光、带细点肌理，颗粒足以柔化其他部分干净的轮廓。空间较浅，却借层叠弧形、缩小尺度及冷暖色带交替保持可辨。上方漫射光使选定顶部和平面温和发亮，没有生硬投影。宽阔装饰形状始终占主导，微小细节则提供生气。整体完成面平静、俏皮且有故事书气息，在图形简化与可触印刷表面之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Small figures by a turquoise pool among rounded golden hills and white houses
theme_zh: 小人物站在绿松石色水池旁，四周是圆形金丘与白色房屋
name: Agostino Iacurci
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
